Why Living Colour

What our customers mention most

We’ve been painting Auckland homes and businesses since 2014. These are the things people bring up again and again in their reviews.

Communication you can rely on

You’ll always know what’s happening and when. If you’re away, we send progress photos so you can watch the job come together.

“Excellent communication, including ongoing photos of his progress.” Anna, Takapuna

Prep done properly

Paint only lasts on a sound surface. We wash, scrape, fill, sand and prime before any topcoat goes on, and the owner checks the work.

“The painters were diligent, polite and proud of their work.” Suzanne, Albany

On time, often ahead

You get a realistic timeframe up front and we stick to it. Plenty of our jobs wrap up ahead of schedule.

“Finished ahead of schedule, fantastic job.” Marilyn, Glenfield

Short notice & Saturdays

Lease about to end? House going on the market? We’ll do our best to fit urgent work in, and we work Saturdays.

“They took our job at short notice and got it done in record time.” Feroz, Massey

Honest, detailed quotes

An itemised quote that shows exactly what’s included, so you can compare like with like. No surprises halfway through.

“Not the cheapest quotation that I got but am pleased I went with them.” Brian, Epsom

A tidy site, every day

Drop sheets down, furniture covered, rubbish taken away. We’re easy to have around, and we leave the place tidy.

“Very professional and easy to work around.” Karen, Freemans Bay

How it works

From first call to final walk-through

A simple, predictable process, so you know what happens next at every stage.

  1. Get in touch

    Call, email or send a few photos through our quote form.

  2. Site visit & quote

    We look over the job and send a detailed, itemised quote.

  3. Colour help

    Stuck on colours? We can arrange a colour specialist.

  4. Prep & protect

    Floors and gardens covered. Surfaces cleaned, filled and sanded.

  5. Paint

    Quality Resene or Dulux paint, applied with care.

  6. Walk-through

    We check the finish with you and leave the site tidy.

Owner-operated

One person looking after your job, start to finish

Living Colour is owner-operated. When you call, you talk to the person who will visit, quote, run the job, check the team’s work and keep you posted until it’s done.

Our background covers homes, offices, shops and schools, including five years of new-build work for Fletcher Living at Red Beach and Horncastle at Millwater, and insurance reinstatement work for Vero. On bigger jobs we organise the scaffolders and cleaners too, so you only deal with one person.

FAQ

Good questions, straight answers

The things people usually ask before they book. Can’t see yours? Give us a call.

All FAQs Ask us
Are your quotes free?

Yes. Quotes are free and there’s no obligation. For most jobs we come and look at the work in person, then send you a written, itemised quote so you can see exactly what’s included.

Which paints do you use?

We use quality Resene and Dulux paints, matched to the surface and the conditions. If you have a particular product or colour range in mind, just let us know.

What happens if it rains?

Exterior paint needs dry surfaces and the right temperature to cure properly, so we won’t paint outside in the rain. We keep an eye on the forecast, shift to prep or interior work where we can, and tell you early if the timeline moves.

Are you insured?

Yes. We carry public liability insurance up to $2,000,000 and defective-workmanship cover up to $100,000. The owner also holds a Site Safe passport and is certified for working at heights and elevating work platforms.

Do you take on small jobs?

Yes. No job is too big or too small: a single room, a bathroom, a fence or a few repairs before you sell. Small jobs get the same prep and care as big ones.
